intro: 电源或负载不是正弦的时候（方波、整流电压、含谐波的电网电压……），把周期信号分解成**直流 + 各次谐波**，每个分量用已经学过的直流分析和相量法单独求解，再在时域叠加。本章最重要的习惯：**每次谐波重算电抗，有效值平方和开方，平均功率按谐波相加**。相量默认取有效值，一律以 cos 为参考。

en.intro: When a source or load is not sinusoidal (square waves, rectified voltages, mains voltage with harmonics, …), split the periodic signal into **DC + harmonics**, solve each component with the DC analysis and phasor methods you already know, and add the results in the time domain. The key habits of this chapter: **recompute the reactances for every harmonic, combine rms values as a root of a sum of squares, add average powers harmonic by harmonic**. Phasors are rms phasors with the cosine reference.

ideas.title: 非正弦周期量 = 直流 + 各次谐波
text: 方波、三角波、整流电压等非正弦周期量（周期 T，ω_1 = 2π/T）满足狄利赫利条件时可以展开成傅里叶级数：f(t) = A_0 + Σ A_km cos(kω_{1}t + φ_k)。A_0 是**直流分量**（平均值），k = 1 是**基波**，k ≥ 2 是 k 次**谐波**，频率都是基波的整数倍。
把 A_km 按 k 画成竖线就是**振幅频谱**：周期信号的频谱是离散的。波形越“陡”（有跳变），高次谐波衰减越慢：方波按 1/k，三角波按 1/k²，所以工程上取有限项就够了。
本章一律以 cos 为参考：给出 sin 形式时先改写，sin x = cos(x − 90°)。

en.title: A non-sinusoidal periodic quantity = DC + harmonics
text: Square waves, triangle waves, rectified voltages and other non-sinusoidal periodic quantities (period T, ω_1 = 2π/T) that satisfy the Dirichlet conditions expand into a Fourier series f(t) = A_0 + Σ A_km cos(kω_{1}t + φ_k). A_0 is the **DC component** (average value), k = 1 the **fundamental**, k ≥ 2 the k-th **harmonic** — all at integer multiples of the fundamental frequency.

Plotting A_km against k gives the **amplitude spectrum**: a periodic signal has a discrete spectrum. The steeper the waveform (jumps), the slower the harmonics decay: 1/k for a square wave, 1/k² for a triangle — so a finite number of terms is enough in practice.
This chapter uses the cosine reference throughout: rewrite a sine first, sin x = cos(x − 90°).

ideas.title: 用对称性判断哪些谐波存在
text: **偶函数** f(−t) = f(t)：只有余弦项（b_k = 0）。**奇函数** f(−t) = −f(t)：只有正弦项（a_k = 0），且直流分量为零。**半波对称** f(t + T/2) = −f(t)：只有奇次谐波（没有直流和偶次谐波）。
奇偶性与计时起点有关，移动 t = 0 只改变各次谐波的初相，不改变振幅；半波对称与计时起点无关。先看对称性，可以少算一半的系数，也能用来检查结果。

en.title: Symmetry tells which harmonics exist
text: **Even** function f(−t) = f(t): cosine terms only (b_k = 0). **Odd** function f(−t) = −f(t): sine terms only (a_k = 0) and no DC component. **Half-wave symmetry** f(t + T/2) = −f(t): odd harmonics only (no DC, no even harmonics).

Even/odd depends on the time origin; moving t = 0 changes only the initial phases, not the amplitudes. Half-wave symmetry does not depend on the origin. Checking the symmetry first halves the work and is a good check of the result.

ideas.title: 有效值、平均值与仪表读数
text: 有效值仍按定义 I = √(\frac{1}{T}∫_{0}^{T} i² dt)。代入傅里叶级数，不同频率的乘积在一个周期内平均为零，得到 **I = √(I_0² + I_1² + I_2² + …)**，I_k = I_km/√2 是 k 次谐波的有效值。有效值**不能**直接相加，也和各次谐波的初相无关。
**平均值**就是直流分量 I_0；**绝对平均值** \frac{1}{T}∫_{0}^{T}|i| dt（整流平均值）在整流电路里用得多。
仪表：磁电系（动圈式）读平均值（直流分量）；电磁系、电动系读有效值；整流式仪表按绝对平均值 × 1.11 刻度，只有测正弦量时才准。功率表（电动系）读平均功率。

en.title: rms value, average value and meter readings
text: The rms value is still I = √(\frac{1}{T}∫_{0}^{T} i² dt). Substituting the Fourier series, products of different frequencies average to zero over a period, so **I = √(I_0² + I_1² + I_2² + …)**, where I_k = I_km/√2 is the rms value of harmonic k. rms values **never** add directly and do not depend on the harmonics' initial phases.
The **average value** is the DC component I_0; the **absolute (rectified) average** \frac{1}{T}∫_{0}^{T}|i| dt is common in rectifier circuits.

Meters: a moving-coil meter reads the average value (DC component); moving-iron and electrodynamic meters read the rms value; a rectifier-type meter is scaled as absolute average × 1.11 and is correct for sine waves only. An (electrodynamic) wattmeter reads the average power.

ideas.title: 平均功率 = 各次谐波功率之和
text: 一端口的 u、i（关联参考方向）都是非正弦周期量时，p = ui 的平均值中只有**同频率**的电压、电流相乘才有贡献：**P = U_{0}I_0 + Σ U_{k}I_k cos φ_k**，φ_k 是 k 次谐波电压与电流的相位差。
所以不同频率的电源各自产生的功率可以叠加（直流源只和电流的直流分量交换功率）；同频率的电源则不行。视在功率 S = UI（有效值之积），功率因数只能定义为 λ = P/S，它没有对应的“阻抗角”。

en.title: Average power = sum of the harmonic powers
text: When u and i of a port (passive sign convention) are both non-sinusoidal periodic, only products of voltage and current at the **same frequency** contribute to the average of p = ui: **P = U_{0}I_0 + Σ U_{k}I_k cos φ_k**, where φ_k is the phase difference between the k-th harmonics of voltage and current.

So powers produced by sources of different frequencies superpose (a DC source exchanges power only with the DC component of its current); sources of the same frequency do not. The apparent power is S = UI (product of rms values), and the power factor can only be defined as λ = P/S — there is no single impedance angle.

ideas.title: 谐波分析法：分别求解，时域叠加
text: 线性电路在非正弦周期激励下的稳态响应用**叠加定理**求：
1. 把激励分解成直流和各次谐波（取到题目规定的次数）；
2. 直流分量单独作用：电感短路、电容开路，按电阻电路求；
3. 每个 k 次谐波单独作用：用相量法，感抗 X_Lk = kω_{1}L，容抗 X_Ck = 1/(kω_{1}C)——**每一次谐波的阻抗都要重算**；
4. 把各分量的响应写成**时域**表达式再相加；不同频率的相量不能相加。最后按需要求有效值、平均功率。

en.title: Harmonic analysis: solve each component, add in the time domain
text: The steady-state response of a linear circuit to a non-sinusoidal periodic source follows from **superposition**:
1. split the source into its DC component and harmonics (up to the order the problem states);
2. DC alone: inductors shorted, capacitors open — a resistive circuit;
3. each harmonic k alone: phasors with X_Lk = kω_{1}L and X_Ck = 1/(kω_{1}C) — **recompute the impedances for every harmonic**;
4. write each response in the **time domain** and add; phasors of different frequencies never add. Then compute rms values and average power as needed.

ideas.title: 谐波谐振与滤波
text: 因为电抗随 k 变化，电路可能只对某一次谐波谐振：LC 串联支路在 kω_1 = 1/√(LC) 时阻抗为零（对该谐波**短路**），LC 并联支路此时阻抗为无穷大（对该谐波**开路**）。
利用这一点可以设计滤波器：并联 LC 串在线路里挡住某次谐波，串联 LC 并在负载两端把某次谐波旁路掉；再加一个电容或电感，让整个支路对基波串联谐振，使基波无损通过。电感、电容组成的低通滤波器则利用高次谐波的容抗小、感抗大来压低纹波。
谐波谐振时，即使该次谐波的电压很小，电流或元件电压也可能很大，要逐次检查。

en.title: Harmonic resonance and filters
text: Because reactances change with k, a circuit can be resonant at one harmonic only: a series LC branch has zero impedance at kω_1 = 1/√(LC) (a **short** for that harmonic), a parallel LC infinite impedance (an **open** for that harmonic).

Filters use this: a parallel LC in the line blocks one harmonic, a series LC across the load bypasses it; one more capacitor or inductor puts the whole branch in series resonance at the fundamental so that it passes unattenuated. LC/RC low-pass filters reduce ripple because the harmonics see small capacitive and large inductive reactances.
At a harmonic resonance a small harmonic voltage can produce a large current or element voltage — check harmonic by harmonic.

ideas.title: 三相电路中的高次谐波
text: 对称三相电源的 k 次谐波依次相差 k × 120°：k = 1、7、13…为**正序**，k = 5、11…为**负序**，k = 3、9…（3 的倍数）三相**同相**，为**零序**。
零序谐波的特点：线电压中互相抵消，所以 U_l < √3U_p；星形有中线时三相的零序电流在中线中相加，I_N = 3I_3；星形无中线时零序电流为零，零序电压出现在两个中性点之间，U_{N'N} = U_3；三角形联结的绕组中零序电动势形成环流，线电压中没有零序分量。

en.title: Harmonics in three-phase circuits
text: In a balanced three-phase source the k-th harmonics are k × 120° apart: k = 1, 7, 13, … are **positive sequence**, k = 5, 11, … **negative sequence**, and k = 3, 9, … (multiples of 3) are **in phase** — **zero sequence**.

Zero-sequence harmonics cancel in line voltages, so U_l < √3U_p; in a Y system with a neutral the three zero-sequence currents add up in the neutral, I_N = 3I_3; without a neutral the zero-sequence current is zero and the zero-sequence voltage appears between the two neutral points, U_{N'N} = U_3; inside delta-connected windings the zero-sequence EMFs drive a circulating current and the line voltages contain no zero-sequence component.

formulas.name: 傅里叶级数（cos 参考）
formulas.expr: f(t) = A_0 + Σ_{k=1}^{∞} A_km cos(kω_{1}t + φ_k)
formulas.when: f 是周期为 T 的周期函数（满足狄利赫利条件）；ω_1 = 2π/T；A_km ≥ 0 为 k 次谐波的振幅（幅值）。

en.name: Fourier series (cosine reference)
en.expr: f(t) = A_0 + Σ_{k=1}^{∞} A_km cos(kω_{1}t + φ_k)
en.when: f periodic with period T (Dirichlet conditions); ω_1 = 2π/T; A_km ≥ 0 is the amplitude (peak) of harmonic k.

formulas.name: 系数
formulas.expr: A_0 = \frac{1}{T}∫_{0}^{T} f dt，a_k = \frac{2}{T}∫_{0}^{T} f cos kω_{1}t dt，b_k = \frac{2}{T}∫_{0}^{T} f sin kω_{1}t dt，A_km = √(a_k² + b_k²)
formulas.when: f = A_0 + Σ(a_k cos kω_{1}t + b_k sin kω_{1}t)；化成 cos 形式时 A_km cos φ_k = a_k，A_km sin φ_k = −b_k（注意象限）。

en.name: Coefficients
en.expr: A_0 = \frac{1}{T}∫_{0}^{T} f dt, a_k = \frac{2}{T}∫_{0}^{T} f cos kω_{1}t dt, b_k = \frac{2}{T}∫_{0}^{T} f sin kω_{1}t dt, A_km = √(a_k² + b_k²)
en.when: f = A_0 + Σ(a_k cos kω_{1}t + b_k sin kω_{1}t); in the cosine form A_km cos φ_k = a_k, A_km sin φ_k = −b_k (mind the quadrant).

formulas.name: 对称性
formulas.expr: 偶函数：b_k = 0；奇函数：A_0 = a_k = 0；半波对称：A_0 = 0，偶次谐波为 0
formulas.when: 偶/奇：f(−t) = ±f(t)，与计时起点有关；半波对称：f(t + T/2) = −f(t)，与计时起点无关。

en.name: Symmetry
en.expr: even: b_k = 0; odd: A_0 = a_k = 0; half-wave symmetry: A_0 = 0, no even harmonics
en.when: even/odd: f(−t) = ±f(t), depends on the time origin; half-wave: f(t + T/2) = −f(t), independent of the origin.

formulas.name: 常用波形（峰值 A）
formulas.expr: 方波 ±A：\frac{4A}{kπ}（k 奇）；三角波 ±A：\frac{8A}{k²π²}（k 奇）；全波整流 A|cos|：A_0 = \frac{2A}{π}，A_km = \frac{4A}{π(4k² − 1)}
formulas.when: 全波整流电压的基波频率是原正弦频率的 2 倍（50 Hz 市电整流后为 100 Hz）；锯齿波 0→A：A_0 = A/2，A_km = \frac{A}{kπ}；半波整流：A_0 = A/π，A_1m = A/2。

en.name: Standard waveforms (peak A)
en.expr: square ±A: \frac{4A}{kπ} (k odd); triangle ±A: \frac{8A}{k²π²} (k odd); full-wave rectified A|cos|: A_0 = \frac{2A}{π}, A_km = \frac{4A}{π(4k² − 1)}
en.when: the fundamental of a full-wave rectified voltage is twice the frequency of the sine (100 Hz from 50 Hz mains); sawtooth 0→A: A_0 = A/2, A_km = \frac{A}{kπ}; half-wave rectified: A_0 = A/π, A_1m = A/2.

formulas.name: 有效值
formulas.when: I_0 为直流分量，I_k 为 k 次谐波的有效值；与各次谐波的初相无关。电压同理。

en.name: rms value
en.when: I_0 is the DC component, I_k the rms value of harmonic k; independent of the initial phases. The same for voltages.

formulas.name: 常用波形的有效值与平均值
formulas.expr: 方波 A：U = A；三角波、锯齿波：U = A/√3；全波整流：U = A/√2，U_0 = 2A/π，K_f = U/U_0 = 1.11
formulas.when: A 为峰值；三角波和锯齿波的有效值相同（都是线性变化）；整流不改变有效值。

en.name: rms and average of standard waveforms
en.expr: square A: U = A; triangle and sawtooth: U = A/√3; full-wave rectified: U = A/√2, U_0 = 2A/π, K_f = U/U_0 = 1.11
en.when: A is the peak value; triangle and sawtooth have the same rms value (both linear); rectifying does not change the rms value.

formulas.name: 平均值与绝对平均值
formulas.when: 磁电系仪表读 I_0；整流式仪表按 1.11·I_{av} 刻度（只对正弦量准确）。

en.name: Average and absolute average
en.when: a moving-coil meter reads I_0; a rectifier-type meter is scaled as 1.11·I_{av} (correct for sine waves only).

formulas.name: 平均功率
formulas.expr: P = U_{0}I_0 + Σ U_{k}I_k cos φ_k
formulas.when: u、i 为关联参考方向（P 为吸收功率）；U_k、I_k 为 k 次谐波的有效值，φ_k = ψ_uk − ψ_ik；不同频率的 u、i 不产生平均功率。电阻：P = I²R（I 为有效值）。

en.name: Average power
en.expr: P = U_{0}I_0 + Σ U_{k}I_k cos φ_k
en.when: u, i in the passive sign convention (P absorbed); U_k, I_k rms values of harmonic k, φ_k = ψ_uk − ψ_ik; voltage and current of different frequencies give no average power. Resistor: P = I²R (I rms).

formulas.name: 视在功率与功率因数
formulas.when: U、I 为非正弦量的有效值；λ 不能写成某个阻抗角的余弦。

en.name: Apparent power and power factor
en.when: U, I rms values of the non-sinusoidal quantities; λ is not the cosine of any impedance angle.

formulas.name: k 次谐波的阻抗
formulas.expr: Z_k = R + j(kω_{1}L − \frac{1}{kω_{1}C})；k = 0：L 短路、C 开路
formulas.when: 线性时不变 R、L、C；每次谐波单独用相量法求解，响应在时域相加。

en.name: Impedance at harmonic k
en.expr: Z_k = R + j(kω_{1}L − \frac{1}{kω_{1}C}); k = 0: L shorted, C open
en.when: linear time-invariant R, L, C; solve each harmonic with phasors on its own and add the responses in the time domain.

formulas.name: 谐波谐振
formulas.expr: kω_1 = \frac{1}{\sqrt{LC}}：LC 串联支路对 k 次谐波短路，LC 并联支路对 k 次谐波开路
formulas.when: 理想（无损）L、C；对其他次谐波，LC 并联支路的阻抗为 jkω_{1}L/(1 − k²ω_1²LC)。

en.name: Harmonic resonance
en.expr: kω_1 = \frac{1}{\sqrt{LC}}: a series LC is a short and a parallel LC an open at harmonic k
en.when: ideal (lossless) L, C; at other harmonics a parallel LC has impedance jkω_{1}L/(1 − k²ω_1²LC).

formulas.name: 零序（3 的倍数次）谐波
formulas.expr: Y 有中线：I_N = 3I_3；Y 无中线：U_{N'N} = U_3；Δ：环流 I_3 = E_3/|Z_3|，线电压无 3 次谐波
formulas.when: 对称三相电源和对称负载；Z_3 为每个绕组（或每相）对 3 次谐波的阻抗；9、15… 次谐波同理。

en.name: Zero-sequence (multiple-of-3) harmonics
en.expr: Y with neutral: I_N = 3I_3; Y without neutral: U_{N'N} = U_3; Δ: circulating I_3 = E_3/|Z_3|, no 3rd harmonic in line voltages
en.when: balanced three-phase source and load; Z_3 is the impedance of one winding (or phase) at the 3rd harmonic; the same for the 9th, 15th, … harmonics.

formulas.name: 线电压与相电压
formulas.when: 对称三相星形联结；线电压中不含 3 的倍数次谐波。

en.name: Line and phase voltage
en.when: balanced Y connection; the line voltage contains no harmonics of order a multiple of 3.

examples.title: 直流 + 基波 + 2 次谐波作用于 RL 电路
examples.statement: u_s = 10 + 50√2 cos(1000t) + 20√2 cos(2000t) V 加在 R = 30 Ω、L = 40 mH 串联的电路上。求电流的各分量、电流有效值 I、电源电压有效值 U 和平均功率 P。

en.title: DC + fundamental + 2nd harmonic in an RL circuit
en.statement: u_s = 10 + 50√2 cos(1000t) + 20√2 cos(2000t) V drives R = 30 Ω in series with L = 40 mH. Find the components of the current, the rms current I, the rms source voltage U and the average power P.
steps: 1. **DC component** (inductor shorted): I_0 = 10/30 = **0.3333 A**, P_0 = I_0²R = 3.333 W.

examples.title: 并联 LC 挡住基波，取出 3 次谐波
examples.statement: u_s = 100√2 cos(1000t) + 20√2 cos(3000t) V，经 L = 10 mH 与 C = 100 µF 的并联支路接到 R = 10 Ω 上。求输出 u_o 中的基波和 3 次谐波（有效值）以及 u_o 的有效值。

results.ask: 基波时 LC 两端电压
基波时 L 中电流 I_L1
3 次谐波时 LC 的电抗

steps: 1. **看谐振频率。** 1/√(LC) = 1/√(0.01 × 100×10⁻⁶) = 1000 rad/s，恰好是基波角频率（f_0 = 159.2 Hz）：L∥C 对基波**并联谐振**，相当于开路。
2. **基波：** 负载中没有基波电流，U_o1 = **0**。100 V 的基波电压全部加在 LC 上，I_L1 = 100/(ωL) = 10 A，在 L、C 之间循环。
4. **输出：** u_o 中只剩 3 次谐波，U_o = **18.73 V**——这个电路把 3 次谐波“取”了出来，而且只衰减了 6%。

en.title: A parallel LC blocks the fundamental and extracts the 3rd harmonic
en.statement: u_s = 100√2 cos(1000t) + 20√2 cos(3000t) V feeds R = 10 Ω through L = 10 mH in parallel with C = 100 µF. Find the fundamental and 3rd-harmonic components (rms) of the output u_o and the rms value of u_o.

results.ask: resonant frequency f_0 of the LC
voltage across the LC at the fundamental
current in L at the fundamental, I_L1
reactance of the LC at the 3rd harmonic

steps: 1. **Resonant frequency.** 1/√(LC) = 1/√(0.01 × 100×10⁻⁶) = 1000 rad/s, exactly the fundamental (f_0 = 159.2 Hz): L∥C is in **parallel resonance** at the fundamental — an open circuit.
2. **Fundamental:** no fundamental current reaches the load, U_o1 = **0**. The whole 100 V fundamental is across the LC: I_L1 = 100/(ωL) = 10 A circulates between L and C.
4. **Output:** only the 3rd harmonic is left, U_o = **18.73 V** — the circuit “extracts” the 3rd harmonic, attenuating it by only 6 %.

mistakes.text: 把各次谐波的有效值直接相加（例如 10 + 100 + 30 = 140 V）。有效值要平方和再开方：√(10² + 100² + 30²) = 104.9 V。

en.text: Adding the harmonics' rms values directly (e.g. 10 + 100 + 30 = 140 V). rms values combine as the root of the sum of squares: √(10² + 100² + 30²) = 104.9 V.

mistakes.text: 把基波相量和 3 次谐波相量相加得到一个“总相量”。不同频率的相量没有意义地相加——只能各自写成时域式再相加。

en.text: Adding the fundamental and 3rd-harmonic phasors into a “total phasor”. Phasors of different frequencies cannot be added — write each in the time domain and add there.

mistakes.text: 所有谐波都用基波的感抗、容抗计算。k 次谐波的感抗是 kω_{1}L，容抗是 1/(kω_{1}C)；直流时电感短路、电容开路。

en.text: Using the fundamental's reactances for every harmonic. At harmonic k the inductive reactance is kω_{1}L and the capacitive one 1/(kω_{1}C); at DC the inductor is a short and the capacitor open.

mistakes.text: 把谐波振幅当成有效值代入（100√2 cos ωt 的有效值是 100 V，不是 141.4 V）；或者用 U_m²/(2R) 求非正弦电压的功率。

en.text: Using a harmonic's amplitude as its rms value (100√2 cos ωt has rms 100 V, not 141.4 V), or using U_m²/(2R) for the power of a non-sinusoidal voltage.

mistakes.text: 认为不同频率的电压和电流相乘也有平均功率，或者反过来以为同频率的两个电源产生的功率也能叠加。只有同频率的 u、i 才产生平均功率；所以只有不同频率的电源，功率才能叠加。

en.text: Thinking that a voltage and a current of different frequencies produce average power — or, conversely, that powers from two sources of the same frequency superpose. Only same-frequency u and i give average power, so powers superpose only for sources of different frequencies.

mistakes.text: 求电容电压、电源电压的有效值或电压表读数时漏掉直流分量。电容隔直，但电容两端的直流电压往往不为零。

en.text: Forgetting the DC component in the rms value of a capacitor or source voltage or a voltmeter reading. A capacitor blocks DC current, yet the DC voltage across it is often not zero.

mistakes.text: 含 3 次谐波时仍用 U_l = √3U_p。零序谐波在线电压中抵消，U_l 只由正序、负序谐波决定，比 √3U_p 小。

en.text: Still using U_l = √3U_p when 3rd harmonics are present. Zero-sequence harmonics cancel in the line voltage, which depends on the positive- and negative-sequence harmonics only and is smaller than √3U_p.
